item.tib: rig 'dzin thugs kyis rtsa rgyud drag gcod nyams su len thabs las lam khyer gcod kyi lag len 'phrul gyi me longs
item.coloph: de ltar drag gcod kyi nang nas rgyun khyer nyams su len pa'i lag len 'od ldan li yi me long zhes bya ba drin can mchog chen po'i mched zla drung mu tshu mi'i bka' dang snying grogs drung mu khi khar gyis nan bskul ngo (ngor/)snyom las pa gsang sngags gling pas dran shar ngag las thon bzhin pradz+nya tshu mi'i (mis) sug bris bgyis pa me 'brug zla ba dang por dga' ldan dpal ri'i dbang du grub bo//
